content.short: Centic is a data analytics platform that merges on-chain and off-chain data to create a Web3 scoring system.
content.description: Centic provides a sophisticated Web3 data infrastructure designed to illuminate how complex blockchain networks operate. By combining on-chain activity with relevant off-chain signals, it delivers a clear, holistic view of Web3 entities and their relationships. This approach helps enterprises, foundations, and developers who want to implement customized scoring models to assess risk, track activity, and monitor entities across multiple ecosystems. Centic’s infrastructure supports scalable analysis and streamlined decision making in Web3 projects.
